caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high backrest situated against a plain, light beige background. The chair has a dark brown or black finish on the wood, displaying four elaborately turned legs and multiple turned spindles that form the backrest and side supports. The top of the backrest features a scalloped, arched crest rail with two finials at each end. The seat of the chair is made from a woven material, which is tan or straw-colored, creating a distinct contrast with the dark frame. The chair includes several stretchers between the legs and under the seat for support, also rendered in a matching dark wood tone. There are no additional objects or significant details in the background, keeping the focus entirely on the single chair. There is small, handwritten text in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Banister Back Side Chair
